content:
Maya Chen: Hey team — scheduling a dry-run for the Zephyr VPC private deploy ahead of next Tues' customer handoff. Need ~45m to walk network setup, secrets rotation, canary traffic, and rollback plan. Proposed slots: Tue 10:00-10:45 PST, Wed 14:00-14:45 PST, Thu 09:00-09:45 PST. Who can make any of these?
Sam Patel: Wed 14:00 PST works for me. Also recommend we add 'DB migration rollback test' to the agenda (last time it was flaky).
Kevin O'Rourke: Thu morning would be good on my side but I can swap. FWIW we should include a quick 'k8s node tuning' / resource limits check and a pass on the autoscaler config.
Elaine Gomez: Tue conflicts for me. If we lock Wed I'll prep the secret rotation steps and runbook. Please link the runbook in the thread.
Maya Chen: Great — sounds like Wed 14:00 is the likely winner. Draft agenda (45m):
- 5m: intros & scope / success criteria
- 10m: network/VPC peering and security groups (Kevin)
- 10m: secrets + KMS/HSM checklist (Elaine)
- 10m: canary routing + traffic shift plan (Sam)
- 5m: DB migration rollback test (Ravi)
- 5m: open issues, next steps, post-run notes
Can people confirm owners above and call out any missing items?
Ravi Singh: I can own DB rollback test. Can we add a 15m buffer at the end for log collection/triage? Might be tight otherwise.
Maya Chen: Good call — adding 15m buffer (total 60m). Updated agenda note: final 15m = logs + triage + action items.
Elaine Gomez: Runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/zephyr-vpc-deploy (please read before Wed). Quick snippet to validate peering routes:
```bash
# validate route from app subnet to customer subnet
kubectl exec -it net-check -- curl -sS http://10.10.5.2:8080/health || echo "route fail"
```
Kevin O'Rourke: I'll prepare a diff of autoscaler config and bring the tuning notes. Also will run node-level perf checks beforehand and post commands in thread.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created for Wed 14:00-15:00 PST -> https://calendar.redwood.com/event/zephyr-vpc-dryrun. Invite includes conference bridge + recording on by default.
Sam Patel: I'll own canary routing and will prep traffic shapeshift script + health-check thresholds. Posting snippet here later.
Maya Chen: Final confirmations? If no objections I'll lock Wed 14:00 and send invite to Zephyr leads. @Sam Patel @Kevin O'Rourke @Elaine Gomez @Ravi Singh please react with :thumbsup: once you add your prep items to the agenda doc.
Kevin O'Rourke: :thumbsup: I've added the autoscaler diff to the doc.
Sam Patel: :thumbsup: posting the traffic script in the repo in a bit.
Elaine Gomez: :thumbsup: I'll upload the secret rotation playbook and test checklist by EOD.
Ravi Singh: :thumbsup: prep checklist for DB rollback done, will run locally tomorrow and report.
Maya Chen: Thanks — locking Wed 14:00 and cc'ing the customer-facing PM. Will paste the final agenda + runbook links in the calendar invite. If anything urgent before then, ping me or drop here.
